Job Description:

Decision Enablement

SUMMER INTERN

LOCATION

Horsham, PA

SCHEDULE

Full-time

ORGANIZATION

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA)

TEAM

RKPE, Decision Enablement

DATES

June through mid-August

REPORTS TO

Senior Manager, Decision Enablement

Why This Role Matters

What happens when decision enablement, data, process come together to help organizations make better decisions?

The Decision Enablement team helps Global Regulatory Affairs transform complexity into actionable decisions. We connect business strategy, decision science, data, process excellence, and emerging technologies to help leaders make more informed, transparent, and scalable decisions. This role supports priorities within both the Decision Enablement strategy and the GRA AI Excellence Program.

This internship is ideal for students interested in how organizations adopt new technologies, make strategic decisions, and translate technical capabilities into business value.

The Opportunity

What You’ll Do

- Explore how AI, analytics, and decision science are applied to real-world business challenges

- Support initiatives that integrate AI into regulatory workflows and decision-making

- Participate in stakeholder interviews, workshops, and cross-functional discussions

- Research trends in AI, agentic AI, decision intelligence, and digital transformation

- Help assess opportunities to improve business processes, decision quality, and organizational effectiveness

- Contribute to AI adoption, change management, measurement, and reporting

- Develop executive-ready presentations, summaries, and recommendations

- Collaborate across business and technical teams to connect capabilities with business needs

What You’ll Learn

- How large organizations evaluate and adopt AI technologies

- How decision science and structured approaches strengthen business outcomes

- How leaders consider risk, opportunity, assumptions, and trade-offs

- How AI agents and digital assistants can augment human decision-making

- How cross-functional teams advance digital transformation and organizational change

- How to translate technical concepts into practical business recommendations

- How organizations build sustainable capabilities rather than one-time technology deployments

AI Excellence & Adoption

Support the GRA AI Excellence Program by helping assess organizational AI maturity, gather stakeholder insights, identify adoption opportunities, and contribute to initiatives that accelerate responsible AI use across GRA.

AI Use Cases for Regulatory Decision-Making

Research and evaluate AI and agentic AI opportunities that could improve regulatory workflows, decision-making, knowledge management, and operational effectiveness. Assess business value, stakeholder impact, and adoption considerations.

Decision Science & Decision Quality

Explore how organizations make high-quality decisions in complex environments. Support projects that help leaders evaluate options, understand trade-offs, clarify assumptions, and improve decision transparency.

Decision Intelligence & Business Analytics

Assist in developing decision-ready insights through metrics, dashboards, performance reporting, business storytelling, and scenario analysis.

Digital Transformation & Change Adoption

Support communications, workshops, and engagement activities that help employees adopt AI-enabled workflows, data-informed practices, and new ways of working.

Data & Process Culture

Examine how data quality, governance, process excellence, and organizational behaviors influence decision-making. Help strengthen the foundations required for scalable and trusted decisions.

Future of Work & Human-AI Collaboration

Explore how people and AI can work together effectively, including AI agents, workforce readiness, role evolution, capability building, and the future of decision-making.

Strategic Stakeholder Engagement

Work with leaders, AI champions, and business teams to understand challenges, gather insights, facilitate discussions, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

Qualifications

Required

- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in International Affairs, Health or Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management Information Systems, or a related field

- Strong interest in AI, business strategy, emerging technologies, and decision-making

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities

- Comfort working across business and technical teams

- Curious, collaborative, and willing to learn

Preferred

- Coursework related to AI, business analytics, digital transformation, information systems, or technology strategy

- Experience conducting research, analyzing information, or supporting project work

- Interest in organizational change, innovation, and the future of work

- Exposure to data visualization, process improvement, or technology adoption initiatives

Ideal Candidate

We’re looking for someone who is curious about how organizations make decisions and how emerging technologies shape the future of business. You enjoy connecting people, technology, and ideas to solve problems. While you may not want to build AI systems yourself, you’re excited to understand how AI creates value, supports decisions, and enables organizations to work differently.

You are interested in the business side of innovation, comfortable working with diverse stakeholders, and motivated by the opportunity to help shape how people and technology collaborate in the future.

Permanently authorized to work in the U.S., must not require sponsorship of an employment visa (e.g., H-1B or green card) at the time of application or in the future. Students currently on CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT usually requires future sponsorship for long term employment and do not meet the requirements for this program unless eligible for an alternative long-term status that does not require company sponsorship.

Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers . Job Description Summary

Join GE HealthCare's MIM Commercialized Web Applications team and help build software that healthcare providers will use every day. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll contribute to cloud and on-prem web applications, work alongside experienced engineers and a dedicated mentor, and gain hands-on experience with modern full-stack technologies while developing software in a regulated healthcare environment.

*Please note this position is an in-office position at our Beachwood, Ohio site.

Job Description

*Please note this position is an in-office position at our Beachwood, Ohio site.

As a Software Engineering Intern at GE Healthcare for our MIM Commercialized Web Applications team, you will contribute to our web applications sold to customers – MIMcloud and MIM Anyware.

MIMcloud is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) web application which enables secure, HIPAA-compliant cloud-based storage and exchange of medical images between clinical facilities.

MIM Anyware is an on-premise web application which virtualizes access to our main desktop medical imaging application (MIM) through a web browser.

What You'll Do:

- Contribute full-stack changes to the codebases of MIMcloud and/or MIM Anyware.

- Document code, design specifications, and cybersecurity threat models

- Test code and write unit tests

- Work closely with experienced software engineers, including a personal mentor

- Learn about software engineering principles in an industry environment

- Learn about engineering best practices for development of regulated medical software

- Work on real features with a real-world impact on customers

Technologies

MIMcloud

- Languages: Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, HTML, SASS/CSS

- Frameworks: KTOR, React, JUnit

- Database: PostgreSQL

- Amazon Web Services: ECS, Lambda, RDS, and S3

- Tooling: Git, GitLab, IntelliJ IDEA, Gradle, and Docker Containers

MIM Anyware

- Languages: Java, Scala, TypeScript, HTML, SASS/CSS

- Frameworks: Play! Web Framework, React, Bootstrap, jOOQ, Flyway, JUnit

- Database: PostgreSQL

- Tooling: Git, GitLab, IntelliJ IDEA, sbt, and Docker

What You'll Need:

- Some experience writing code in coursework, projects, or previous internships

- An active pursuit of a bachelor's degree, preferably for computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, or physics

- General problem-solving skills

- Strong analytical thinking

- Communication and organization skills

- An aptitude for math and science

- An existing understanding of medical imaging is not required

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Additional Information

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

About the Team:
The Automated Driving Production Technology Team develops and improves the production technologies, hardware processes, and analytical capabilities that support automated driving systems. We work across engineering, manufacturing, quality, testing, and operations to improve efficiency, scalability, reliability, and performance.

Our team combines expertise in hardware systems, production technology, data science, artificial intelligence, process engineering, and analytics to deliver data-driven improvements to production processes and engineering productivity.

What You Will Do:
We are hiring an intern to support AI and hardware process efficiency initiatives through data analysis, process optimization, automation, and analytical tool development.

AI and Data Science
Analyze production, quality, equipment, test, and operational data to identify trends, bottlenecks, variation, and improvement opportunities.
Apply statistical analysis, machine learning, anomaly detection, and other AI techniques to support predictive insights and process optimization.

Present results clearly to engineers, technical leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Working toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
Coursework or project experience in Python, SQL, MATLAB, statistics, data visualization, or machine learning.
Able to work full-time, 40 hours per week.

Experience with Python libraries or tools such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, statistical process control, optimization, or design of experiments.
Basic understanding of manufacturing, hardware development, robotics, automated testing, embedded systems, or production operations.
Must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
Intent to return to degree program after the completion of the internship.

Do you love the art of using data to solve complex business problems? We do too – and would be excited to have you join our team at Walt Disney World!

What You Will Do:

While each day will be different, with rotating priorities, the main themes for this role include you being a(n):

- Creator: Understand data and use data science skills to deliver mathematical models and ad-hoc statistical analyses.

- Translate business needs into data assets and query them using SQL
- Uncover insights, test hypotheses, identify the “why”, and tell a story
- Develop ad hoc analyses and sustained models
- Paint a picture with data using data visualization tools

- Collaborator: Team up with other data experts.

- Work with business partners to identify and unlock opportunities
- Automate workflows and analysis to ensure faster business decisions
- Work with other data teams to improve platform capabilities around data modeling, data visualization, experimentation, and data architecture

- Learner: Lean into your curiosity to understand business problems, data environments, and people.

- Explore existing and emerging analytical solutions, capabilities, and technologies and incorporate them into your work
- Partner with different teams and departments to understand the complex operation, and gain exposure to different areas of accountability, strategic priorities, and career experiences

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Knowledge of data science/advanced analytic concepts (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, clustering)
- Experience with SQL databases and how to query and curate datasets
- Knowledge of industry leading data visualization tools like Tableau
- Introductory knowledge of Python and how to leverage it for machine learning applications
- Time-management skills, with ability to prioritize multiple requests and communicate status to partners/leadership
- Strong communication, interpersonal skills and ability to condense findings into clear takeaways
- Passionate about how to apply analytics and data to enabling business decisions

- Familiarity with GitLab
- Experience developing presentations and reports using quantitative information for non-technical partners

Education:

Summary

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.

We help manufacturers improve the quality of life for their workforce while increasing production capacity and reducing scrap, repair, and rework costs. As a Robotics Engineering Intern, you will join our Customer Success team onsite in Carson, CA to spearhead advancements in robotic surface treatment applications. Your work will enhance manufacturing efficiency and precision while supporting GMR's mission to innovate and improve industry standards.

This is a paid internship running approximately October 2026 through March 2027. Candidates must be available to start no later than October 1, 2026.

Role & Responsibilities

- Work on our Customer Success team with other cross-functional teams on designing, implementing, and testing systems associated with robotic grinding applications.

Who we are

Lab37 Robotics, is a technology company focused on the development and deployment of robots designed specifically for direct-to-customer food production. Our mission is to revolutionize the food industry by creating innovative robotic solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. We are passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver cutting-edge products that meet the evolving needs of our clients.

About the Role

Build software that interfaces directly with robotic hardware, controls, and perception systems, alongside cloud services and robotic production systems. As a Robotics Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to real engineering projects spanning frontend applications, on-robot services, controller state-machines, and low-level hardware communication. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers across software, robotics, firmware, product, and operations while learning modern software engineering practices in a hardware-centric environment.

This is not a project isolated from production. We expect interns to contribute meaningful code, participate in technical discussions, and help deliver software that reaches real users. You’ll receive mentorship from experienced engineers while taking ownership of well-defined features and projects throughout your internship.

What you’ll do

- Develop production software for robotic control and full-stack systems under the guidance of experienced engineers.

- Implement and test control algorithms, sensor integration, and low-level hardware communication protocols.

- Optimize software for embedded and real-time constraints to ensure reliable robotic performance.

- Build product features, internal tools, dashboards, and operational workflows used by engineering, kitchen operations, and robotics teams.

- Implement APIs, services, and tools using modern engineering practices.

- Partner with software engineers, product managers, and operations teams to understand requirements and translate them into working software.

- Participate in design discussions, code reviews, testing, and technical planning.

- Debug production issues, investigate root causes, and contribute to reliable software solutions.

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.

- Leverage modern AI development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity while maintaining high software quality.

- Learn and apply engineering best practices including testing, observability, version control, and continuous integration.

- Share ideas, ask questions, and actively contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.

What we are looking for

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Strong programming fundamentals in one or more modern programming languages such as C++, Go, Python, Java, or Rust.

- Understanding of software engineering fundamentals including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, debugging, and software design principles.

- Experience building software through coursework, internships, research, personal projects, or open-source contributions.

- Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity to learn unfamiliar technologies.

- Comfort working in a collaborative team environment and communicating technical ideas clearly.

- Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and capacity to learn.

Nice To Have

- Proficiency in C++ and experience with ROS / ROS 2.

- Familiarity with Linux, embedded systems, and real-time operating systems.

- Knowledge of computer vision, sensor fusion, or robotic simulation tools like Gazebo.

- Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows.

- Personal projects, hackathons, robotics, embedded systems, IoT, or hardware-related software.

- Experience using AI-assisted software development tools to improve productivity.

- Open-source contributions or technical leadership in student organizations.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

- Real Ownership

- Contribute directly to production software rather than isolated internship projects.

- Learn From Experienced Engineers

- Work closely with experienced software engineers across frontend, backend, robotics, firmware, and cloud infrastructure.

- Technical Growth

- Gain experience building distributed systems, operational software, and robotics-adjacent applications while learning modern engineering practices.

- Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

- Partner with product, culinary, operations, robotics, firmware, and software engineering teams to solve real-world problems.

- Meaningful Impact

- Your work will directly influence software used in real production environments and help shape the future of automated food production.

Why join us

- Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.

- Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.

- Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.

What else you need to know

This role can be based in our Los Angeles or Pittsburgh office. As a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base starting rate for this role is $25.00 - $35.00/hour per hour.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

This internship offers hands-on experience in full-stack development, data analytics, and emerging technologies within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.

This is a paid internship position with potential eligibility for our $3,000 IT Pathways scholarship. The program runs for 10-12 weeks during Summer 2027, with a primarily onsite presence in our Dallas, TX office.

HOW TO APPLY:

- Submit your application to this job

- Include your resume with relevant coursework and projects

- Provide a link to your portfolio, GitHub, or personal website showcasing your work

- Complete the IT Pathways scholarship application HERE (additional information found under Corgan Scholarships)
